stemMarkdown: A train 240 m long is running at 36 km/h. How many seconds does it take to pass a telegraph pole? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: To pass a pole the train must cover its own length. Speed $= 36 \times \dfrac{5}{18} = 10.0000$ m/s, so time $= \dfrac{240}{10.0000} = 24.0$ seconds.
altSolutionMarkdown: A pole has no length, so the distance is exactly the train's length — nothing else.
